script.problem: It has 6 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The kitchen joke makes light of the Christ sitting at the Lord’s right hand.
Calling the scribes’ robes fancy adds a detail the passage does not give. Jesus calls them long.
Scratchy sackcloth is not necessarily the opposite of long robes. Jesus does not describe the robes’ texture.
Jesus says the prayers were for a show, but He does not say their content could not have included blessings for widows.
Saying Jesus wanted everyone to hear it adds an intention and an audience the passage does not specify.
The passage does not describe how the coins looked next to the rich people’s gifts.
